$comment: Server speech voices. Each entry is { voice } (a prebuilt voice name) or { voiceId } (an id from the Gemini Extended Voice Library, or a voice the owner created with consent; see docs/RUNBOOK.md). A dialect entry overrides its parent language. The defaults are placeholders from the prebuilt list (Kore is the voice in the official examples) and must be auditioned by a person: run `npm run tts:voices -w server`, listen to candidates and to `npm run tts:samples -w server`, then edit this file and set status to "auditioned". Never put a cloned or replicated voice here without the speaker's recorded consent.
